text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I spotted Narita Taishin in front of the school gate, but she seemed less energetic than usual.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'm handling my races just fine, aren't I?
I'm not that fragile...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Shut up, you're way too overprotective!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...What am I doing?
Getting tired, irritated, and taking it out on others...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I really should take a break,
just like they said...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, I parted ways with Narita Taishin,
though her back lacked energy even as she walked away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps fatigue has been catching up with her. It looks like we'll need to reconsider our upcoming racing schedule."
